title: Nature And Functions Of A Stock Exchange
definition: A stock exchange is an organized and regulated financial marketplace where buyers and sellers trade existing shares, debentures, and other securities, providing vital liquidity, capital formation, and price discovery to the economy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding regulatory bodies (SEBI), capital market instruments, and secondary market mechanisms. In Mains (GS Paper III - Indian Economy), it forms the bedrock of resource mobilization, corporate governance, and inclusive growth.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Nature And Functions Of A Stock Exchange.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Difference between Primary and Secondary Markets
